title: Panel Status and Fee Schedule Change Terms by Agreement Type (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
Under the **Network Participation Agreements**, a practice may open or close its panel to new Cascade patients, and Cascade updates fee schedules on a regular cycle. This schedule sets the notice periods for both. It also sets the open-panel commitment of a DHMO primary care dentist.

| Term | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Notice before a panel closure takes effect (calendar days) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 30 | 30 |
| Primary care dentist must keep the panel open while assigned members are below panel capacity | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Panel capacity: assigned DHMO members to accept before the panel may close | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1500 | 0 | 0 |
| Advance written notice before a material fee schedule change takes effect (calendar days) | 30 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Regular fee schedule update timing | Annually on 1 January | Annually on 1 January | Annually on 1 January | Annually on 1 January | Annually on 1 January | Annually on 1 January |

## Explanatory notes

- **Panel capacity** is a count of assigned DHMO members. A primary care dentist under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement must accept 1500 assigned members before the panel may close. A capacity of 0 means the term does not apply to that agreement type.
- **Panel closure notice.** The figure is the number of calendar days of notice before a panel closure takes effect. A figure of 0 under the savings network agreement means no notice period is set.
- **Fee schedule notice.** The figure is the number of calendar days of advance written notice that Cascade gives before a material fee schedule change takes effect.

## Hypothetical examples

- A hypothetical primary care dentist has 1499 assigned members. That is below the panel capacity of 1500, so the panel must stay open. With 1500 assigned members, the panel is no longer below capacity.
- A hypothetical material fee reduction for PPO participating dentists is announced in writing. It cannot take effect until 90 calendar days of written notice have run.
